activation_policy: Only proven or strongly correlated profiles may execute. Missing profiles fail closed.

assumptions: This profile is a deterministic execution-order vector, not a claim that all MajorMUD attacks use these constants.
profiles.safe_fallback: Reject resolution when a profile or evidence reference is unavailable.
profiles.runtime_impact: Provides one auditable shared damage/healing pipeline for combat and spell execution.
profiles.character_save_impact: None; trace is transient unless explicitly persisted by the owning combat save layer.
profiles.world_state_impact: None until the returned magnitude is committed by an owning event sink.
